title: Liam Coen: "Definitely a curve" to getting Jessie Bates ready this week

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Liam Coen: "Definitely a curve" to getting Jessie Bates ready this week
sources.description: The Jaguars made three trades on Monday, but their deal for safety Jessie Bates was the only one that was completed when head coach Liam Coen met with reporters on Monday.
